modelingNotes: Camp North End: 301 Camp Road — procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/clt-cne-301-camp-road.ts

The north-east end of the Army Quartermaster Corps' Building No. 4 (1941–43), the shortest of the three warehouses the depot built south of the Ford plant; its middle was taken down for Kinship West (2022–24) and its south-west end is `clt-cne-1720-statesville`. Renovated by Camp North End as shops and Free Range Brewing. A one-storey red-brick box 61 × 75 m on a concrete loading-dock plinth, two corrugated-metal clerestory monitors crossing its width, lower brick wings along its sides; the north-east end on Camp Road opened up in big black steel windows under black steel awnings, "301 CAMP" painted in white at the corner.
Identity: the red brick box on its grey concrete plinth, the row of black awnings on the Camp Road front, and the two silver monitors over the white roof.

Evidence: - OSM: the outline way/324608422 (height 8) and its 9 parts: the two monitors way/835817783, 835817787 (height 9), the main roof 835814331, 835817784, 835817788 (6.9), the low wings 819519804 (5.5), 835814332 (6), 835817785 (5.8) and the small block 835817786 (4). - Lidar, USGS 3DEP NC Phase 4 Mecklenburg 2016, 1 m (measured, NAVD88): ground 228.1–228.5 (y = 0 is 228.1); roof deck 235.4 (7.3 m); monitor tops 238.2 (10.1 m); the side wings 234.0 (5.9 m), the small block 233.9. OSM's heights are about 0.5–1 m low; the lidar is followed. - Charlotte-Mecklenburg Historic Landmarks Commission survey report (2017, landmarkscommission.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Ford-Motor-Co-Plant-SR.pdf), Buildings Nos. 4, 5, 6 (published): "a matched set", one storey, "brick-faced in common bond with six course headers", 180 ft wide, concrete roofs, "tall clerestory skylights ... crossing the widths of the buildings", "constructed from pressed corrugated sheet metal", 15-pane windows on their short sides and sash windows along the long ones; six monitors on No. 4, which is "only about 700 feet long". - Mecklenburg County tax parcel 07903C99 (CAMP ... PROPERTY OWNER LP): built 1943, face brick. - Camp North End leasing brochure (2021, camp.nc): the name "301 Camp Road", 48,000 sq ft. - Photos (EVIDENCE), all by City Dweller 2, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:301_Camp_along_Camp_Rd_Early_June_2025.jpg https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:301_Camp_artwork_Early_June_2025.jpg https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Free_Range_Brewing_Camp_North_End_in_the_301_Camp_building_Early_June_2025.jpg https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Wildflowers_in_front_of_301_Camp_Early_June_2025.jpg https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Free_Range_Brewing_Late_March_2024.jpg They show the red brick, the pale coping, the grey concrete plinth about 1.3 m high, the Camp Road front and the plaza side mostly glass: tall black-framed bays about two-thirds of the wall high filling each bay between brick piers, a brick band above, flat black steel canopies over them; and the long north-west wall, mostly blind brick under a mural. - Mapillary 360° photo 585774473263517 (cbreedlove, June 2022, CC BY-SA 4.0) of Building No. 4's other end: the monitors are silver corrugated metal with a band of clerestory glazing. - USGS NAIP orthophoto (public domain): the white membrane roofs.

Estimated: the bay pitch (about 7 m, photo-scaled from the 1.3 m plinth) and the glazing's head height; the monitors' glazing band. The south-east wings are seen only in part (the Free Range photos), so their bays repeat the front's at wing height. The south-west face (towards Kinship West) is unphotographed and drawn with a few windows only. Lettering, murals and steps are left out.

This file also holds the kit the south-campus models share (`clt-cne-201-camp-road`, `clt-cne-701-keswick`, `clt-cne-1720-statesville`, `clt-cne-1701-n-graham`, `clt-cne-gama-goat`, `clt-cne-330-camp-road`, `clt-cne-bunkhouse`, `clt-cne-generals-office`), built on the north campus's kit (`clt-cne-hercules-south.ts`, `clt-cne-ford-plant.ts`); its own model is built only when it is run directly.

Frame: the south warehouses' grid. y runs along the long axis (bearing 39.4°), x across it (bearing 129.4°), z up, metres; placement bearing 39.4. The origin is the outline's centroid, lng −80.8340930, lat 35.2457858.
